lesson.title: How the pieces connect
lesson.summary: In modern web applications, pages import reusable interface building blocks and data fetching helpers to assemble views. By separating layout structure, visual components, and database functions into distinct modules, code remains modular and easier to maintain.
lesson.analogy: Like assembling a kitchen, where pre-built cabinets and appliances are brought together into a room layout, and ingredients are fetched from the pantry to cook a meal. The limit of this analogy is that code modules can be duplicated infinitely, whereas physical furniture is unique.
details: Trace a module dependency and explain what crosses that boundary.
